purpose: Test a retained GPU composition backend for a reversible overlay over existing applications.

activities.label: verify retained GPU composition without camera, network or arbitrary execution

queries.question: Can a GPU-composed overlay update only on plan changes without the Python full-frame strobo path?

assumptions: The Windows desktop compositor is available and the hardware D3D11 driver is present.
The pointer and JSONL plan are probes, not gaze ground truth.
The underlying application remains the source of truth.
A display-layout change requires a new runtime instance until WM_DISPLAYCHANGE is implemented.
kill_tests: A static scene must not present continuously.
SetWindowPos must not be called from the render loop.
The backend must not capture the screen or request camera/network access.
The JSONL boundary must not execute arbitrary code.
The overlay must close and release resources after duration or stop.
unknowns: External GPU-engine utilization and temperature under pointer motion.
Whether the visual plan improves a real task without increasing distraction.
The adapter needed to connect the Python semantic controller in 057.
